headline: Executive order directs how federal agencies will carry out the energy and infrastructure parts of the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up how the executive branch will put into action the energy and infrastructure sections of the Inflation Reduction Act, a law passed in 2022. It gives instructions to federal agencies rather than creating new rules for the public. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to carry out the energy and infrastructure parts of the Inflation Reduction Act.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 12, 2022; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
